title: DuckNet backlog build — candidate items
description: Output of the build stage. Deliberately has no field for 'is this already implemented' and no confidence field: an independent verify stage decides both against the code.

summary.description: One to three sentences: what was read and the shape of the backlog produced.

sources.description: What the build actually read. A source listed here must have been opened.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug from the subject, e.g. dashboard-dlq-replay-ui. Stable across runs so re-runs update rather than duplicate issues.

kind.description: epic: a parent that groups stories and is not itself implementable. story: one independently mergeable piece of work.

parent.description: id of an epic in this same array, or null. An epic must have parent null.

body.description: Markdown: motivation, scope, and what is explicitly out of scope.

acceptance_criteria.description: Observable, checkable outcomes. For a story, at least one must be verifiable by a test or a runnable command.

evidence.description: Why this item exists. Every item must trace to something actually read.

detail.description: A short quote from the document, or the symbol/file the gap was observed in.

labels.description: Repository labels. CI adds 'backlog' and 'backlog-build' itself; epics also get 'epic'.

depends_on.description: ids in this same array that must land first. Empty if none. Not the same as parent.

notes.description: Candidates that did not clear the bar, and gaps in the sources. Empty array if none.
